Synopsis:
Reuters' Weekend Reads roundup covers five key themes: (1) AI-generated content proliferation on the web; (2) ghost data centers inflating US power grid demand forecasts; (3) rising human rights abuse allegations (+73% in 2025) in critical minerals mining undermining ESG standards; (4) lessons from China's energy transition for global adaptation; (5) Middle East oil/gas routing alternatives amid the Strait of Hormuz crisis. On the financial side, a Council on Foreign Relations podcast segment examines whether AI-driven corporate debt issuance is materially contributing to the surge in Treasury yields and whether the associated risks to financial markets are overstated, set against the broader US fiscal backdrop.
